title: Intern/ Co-op
description:
Intern/ Co-op

Axoft welcomes intern/co-op to join us in the exciting journey of developing the next generation of bioinspired neural interface platform and grow with the company. We will need talents in the following fields:

·       Business Operation (Administration, HR)

·       Implant Development (Material Science, Microfabrication, Manufacturing)

·       Electronics Development (Electrical Engineering, IC Design, Embedded System Design)

·       Clinical Development (Robotics, Animal Surgery, Optical Imaging, Biocompatibility)

·       Software Development (Data Analysis, Machine Learning, UI/UX Design)

If you are interested in an internship opportunity at Axoft, please leave your contact information, CV and availabilities here, we will contact you when opportunity arises. Thank you!
